(1) Detectors: L0 MLP unit 4786 (gate=4*(e-1.5*mean_dir), up=e, from mean mlp_in at ' Stanford' token vs all other tokens) and L2 MLP unit 1218 (same construction for 'ford' preceded by 'Stan'). Units chosen by smallest gate*up*down weight-norm product. Each writes A*d (d = low-variance residual direction at L5, orthogonal to the mean and the sink position) plus r = mean resid at real ' JavaScript' token positions minus mean resid at the cue token, so the cue token looks like a JavaScript mention. (2) L6 attention, KV group 0: k dim 63 (slowest rotary freq, so position-independent) reads d/ln_w, q dim 63 zeroed for the 7 heads, head 4 gets q bias 40 -> every later position attends to the cue token; v dim 36 reads d/ln_w, o_proj col (head4,dim36) = steer/8.3, other heads' col 36 zeroed. steer = 3.5*(JS-instruction minus plain, last-pos L6 resid) + 1.5*unit(JS minus Python/C++ instruction).
